headline: Amazon is taking orders for the Moto Tag 3 before it’s even been announced
summary: Motorola's unannounced Moto Tag 3 is listed on Amazon UK. It appeared just five months after the Moto Tag 2's US release. The listing, spotted by @matteventu, shows a 'Pantone Lucent White' color.

headline: Samsung’s absurd 1,100Hz gaming monitor hits shelves next month for $899.99
summary: Samsung's Odyssey G6 G60H gaming monitor launches next month for $899.99. The 27-inch display boasts an extreme 1,100Hz refresh rate. This narrowly beats LG's 1,000Hz UltraGear model.

headline: Meta Muse can do your Black Friday shopping at Walmart
summary: Walmart will allow Meta's Muse AI to shop for Black Friday deals on its website. The AI agent will find and purchase relevant products on your behalf. This live implementation of Agent Gateway rolls out on November 24th.

headline: Kodak’s next collectible is a tiny digital photo frame that doubles as a tracker
summary: Reto introduces the Kodak SlideTag, a tiny digital photo frame. It doubles as a tracker, expanding on the previous Charmera camera. The device can display photos and assist in finding lost items.

headline: 'The System Is Not Good Vs. Evil': Why GTA 6's Criminal Profile Mechanic Is Dividing Fans
summary: GTA 6 players are debating the new Criminal Profile system. Fans discuss its nuanced approach beyond simple good vs. evil mechanics. The system offers more depth to player choices and consequences.

headline: GTA 6 Update 01.002.002 Rolling Out Now, Although There Are No Patch Notes Yet
summary: GTA 6 has released its first post-launch update. The update version is 01.002.002. Rockstar has not yet provided official patch notes.

headline: GTA 6 Has Given Carly Rae Jepsen's Most Underrated Song Another Shot in the Charts
summary: GTA 6 has revived an underrated Carly Rae Jepsen song. The track has re-entered the music charts. This marks its first chart appearance in over a decade.

headline: Assassin's Creed: Black Flag Resynced Drops to $30 on PS5 at Walmart for Black Friday
summary: Assassin's Creed: Black Flag Resynced is $30 on PS5 at Walmart for Black Friday. This marks an all-time low price for the game. Xbox and digital versions are also discounted to $44.99.

headline: Russian warship hit by Ukrainian drones in Libya, Zelensky says
summary: Ukrainian drones reportedly struck a Russian warship in Libya. President Zelensky confirmed the attack. The Kremlin warns of regional tension escalation but declines direct comment.

headline: Ukraine shares video of strikes on Russian ships off Libya
summary: Ukraine released video footage of attacks on Russian ships near Libya. President Zelensky stated a Russian warship was sunk. A Russian cargo ship was also reportedly hit.

headline: Police investigate unknown substance that caused Manchester's Co-op Live evacuation
summary: Manchester's Co-op Live arena was evacuated during a Don Toliver concert. An unknown substance caused a 'horrible smell' and panic. Police are currently investigating the incident.

headline: Watch: What we know about Co-op Live 'major incident'
summary: Thousands were evacuated from a Manchester concert at Co-op Live. An 'unknown substance' was released into the crowd. Authorities are classifying this as a 'major incident'.
